description: Message/set updates currently pass all patches generically to backend. Spec §Message/set defines distinct semantic operations: (1) Edit: detect body/bodyType change, push MessageRevision to editHistory, call Peer/deliver. (2) Reactions: handle JSON Pointer patches on reactions/<senderReactionId> map. (3) Delete: handle deletedAt with optional deletedForAll flag (should call Peer/retract). (4) Mark-as-read: handle readAt update. Also missing: sentAt extraction on create (spec says required).
title: Message/set: implement edit, reactions, delete-for-all, mark-as-read
